turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I bring my baby's pram onto the bus folded or does it have to be folded?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ha, I think you mean unfolded? On many buses, yes, there's a space for prams and wheelchairs.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No worries. Wheelchair users usually get priority for that space, so you might be asked to move or fold it if someone needs it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Unrelated, but Our washing machine flooded the kitchen, so I need a new one fast.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get every option on the table before you react, and I'll say when that's the last one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a cheap top loader at the hardware store, they can deliver it tomorrow, but it's really loud.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then a front loader that's super quiet and saves water, but it's about twice the price and takes a week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And my neighbour is selling her two year old machine for almost nothing, though I'd have to collect it myself.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, all done. What's your gut say?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The neighbour's machine is a great deal if it's working well and you can borrow someone to help lift it. The quiet front loader is the best long term, it'll save on water bills. The top loader only wins if you really can't go a week without washing.
